user.title: Connect to Willo
user.description: Open the Willo app, create a home, and enter the pairing code it shows you.

error.invalid_code: That pairing code is invalid or has expired. Generate a new one in the Willo app and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Willo. Check this device's internet connection and try again.

abort.already_configured: This Home Assistant instance is already connected to a Willo home.
abort.claim_requires_data: The claim step requires a home_id and secret; it cannot be started interactively.
abort.claim_invalid_data: The claim step received an invalid or incomplete home_id/secret payload.
